snippet.title: Hold The Line — 4-Player Co-op Zombie Shooter | Official Launch Trailer | Resmi Lansman Fragmanı
snippet.description:
🚨 Hold The Line is now available in Early Access on Steam!

Team up with up to 4 players and defend a failing power core against endless waves of zombies. Build barricades, upgrade your weapons, unlock powerful upgrades, and see how long your team can survive.

Every wave gets harder.
Every upgrade matters.
Every second counts.

Wishlist, play, and help shape the future of Hold The Line.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4727880/Hold_The_Line/
